On Aug. 17th through the 21st I took a week long crash course on how to use R for Data Science.

```{r}
#| label: MPG in city vs highway
#| message: false
#| warning: false
library(tidyverse)

ggplot(
  data = mpg, 
  mapping = aes(
    x = cty,
    y = hwy
  )
)+ geom_point()


```

This is great, but one thing we learned about is the importance of clear labels using the lab functions.

```{r}
#| label: c2
#| echo: true
library(tidyverse)

ggplot(
  data = mpg, 
  mapping = aes(
    x = cty,
    y = hwy
  )
)+ geom_point() + 
  geom_smooth() + 
  labs(
    x = "City Milage",
    y = "Highway Milage", 
    title = "City vs Highway"
  )
```
